title: AAC (Advanced Audio Coding) signature
summary: An AAC file in ADTS (Audio Data Transport Stream) format begins with the 12-bit sync word 0xFFF (0xFF 0xF0 or 0xFF 0xF1) followed by 4 bits of configuration. Raw AAC (no container) has no magic number.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: ADTS sync word: 0xFFF (12 bits) at the start of each frame.

ADTS header: sync (12) + ID (1) + layer (2) + protection (1) + profile (2) + sampling freq (4) + private (1) + channel config (3) + original (1) + home (1) + copyright (1) + copyright start (1) + frame length (13) + buffer fullness (11) + number of frames (2) + CRC (16, optional).
AAC is used in MP4 (M4A), YouTube, Apple Music, etc.
AAC provides better quality than MP3 at the same bitrate.
